text: Documented REST API with resource-oriented URLs, JSON request bodies and JSON responses
quote: The Flagright API is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses

text: Docs MCP server that AI clients such as Claude Code or Cursor can connect to
quote: For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.flagright.com/_mcp/server

text: A clean Markdown version of any docs page is available by appending .md to its URL
quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL

text: Webhooks push real-time JSON notifications over HTTPS, and one endpoint can subscribe to multiple events
quote: A webhook enables Flagright to push real-time notifications to your app. Flagright uses HTTPS to send these notifications to your app as a JSON payload.

text: Webhook events fire when a SAR is created, submitted or accepted, or when the regulator sends a message
quote: A Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) is created, submitted, or accepted by the regulator, or a message is received from the regulator on a submitted SAR.

text: Webhook delivery is retried for up to 3 days on 3xx, 4xx or 5xx responses
quote: Flagright webhooks have built-in retry methods for 3xx, 4xx, or 5xx response status codes. We will retry for up to 3 days

text: Webhook events are signed in the X-Flagright-Signature header so receivers can verify them
quote: Flagright signs the webhook events it sends to your endpoints by including a signature in each event's `X-Flagright-Signature` header.

text: Webhook endpoint secrets can be rolled from the Console, optionally keeping the old secret active for a period
quote: when you roll an endpoint's secret from the Flagright Console, and choose to keep the previous secret active for some period of time

text: Official API clients for Python and Node/TypeScript
quote: Flagright maintains official API clients for Python and Node/Typescript. We recommend using these clients to interact with all stable endpoints.

text: The API can be used directly via Postman
quote: You can interact with the API directly via Postman.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI specs for the FRAML API and the Management API
quote: Download FRAML API OpenAPI ... Download Management API OpenAPI

text: Transaction payloads can be submitted to an endpoint for verification, with most fields optional
quote: In order to pass the payload of a transaction to Flagright and verify the transaction, you will need to call this endpoint with the transaction payload. Not all fields are mandatory

text: Consumer users are created with a client-supplied unique userId and a created timestamp
quote: Each consumer user needs two mandatory fields: `userId` - Unique identifier for the user, `createdTimestamp`

text: The CRA risk level for a user can be optionally locked
quote: `lockCraRiskLevel` (enum, optional) — Boolean string whether Flagright should lock the CRA risk level for the user.

text: Retrieve a user's full payload and rule execution results by userId
quote: Calling `GET /consumer/user/{userId}` will return the entire user payload and rule execution results for the user with the corresponding `userId`

text: Batch creation of consumer and business users, with counts of successful and failed records and the failed records returned
quote: POST https://sandbox.api.flagright.com/batch/consumer/users ... `successful` (double, required) `failed` (double, required) `failedRecords`

text: Sandbox API servers available in the eu-1 and asia-1 regions
quote: `https://sandbox.api.flagright.com` (Sandbox API server (eu-1), default) `https://sandbox-asia-1.api.flagright.com` (Sandbox API server (asia-1))

text: List supported rule templates, or fetch a single one, via the API
quote: `GET /rules` endpoint returns a lot of all rule templates supported by flagright.

text: Create live rule instances via the API that run checks on transactions
quote: `POST /rule-instances` endpoint is used to create a new rule instance. A rule instance can be thought of as a live entity, that runs checks for for transactions.

text: Rule instances can be updated idempotently via the API
quote: Created rule instances can be idempotently updated with the `POST /rule-instances/{ruleInstanceId}`.

text: Case statuses include open, closed, reopened, in progress and on hold, plus custom status IDs
quote: The status can be one of the following values: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, `REOPENED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `ON_HOLD`, or a custom status ID (e.g. `CS-1`).

text: Cases can be filtered by status, including in review and escalated
quote: `filterCaseStatus` (list of enum, optional) - Allowed values: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, `REOPENED`, `IN_REVIEW`, `ESCALATED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `ON_HOLD`

text: Create cases through the Management API
quote: Case - Create POST https://sandbox.api.flagright.com/management/cases

text: Retrieve alerts by ID through the Management API
quote: Alert - Get GET https://sandbox.api.flagright.com/management/alerts/{alertId}

text: Alert statuses include open, cleared and escalated
quote: `status` (enum, optional) - Allowed values: `OPEN`, `CLEARED`, `ESCALATED`

text: Transaction monitoring that detects financial crime in real time or after the fact
quote: Transaction Monitoring - Detect and prevent financial crime in real-time or post.

text: Dynamic risk scoring that continuously reassesses risk as behavior changes
quote: Dynamic Risk Scoring - Reassess risk continuously as behavior changes.

text: Explainable AI agents for AML operations
quote: AI Agents - Supercharge AML operations with explainable AI agents.

text: Automated SAR filing to FinCEN and more than 70 goAML countries
quote: Regulatory Filing - Automate SAR filing to FinCEN and 70+ GoAML countries.

text: Case management that centralizes investigations with AI-native workflows
quote: Case Management - Centralize investigations with AI-native workflows.

text: No-code rule engine supporting nested logic
quote: Rule Engine - Build sophisticated rules using nested, no-code logic.

text: Watchlist screening with fully configurable matching algorithms
quote: Watchlist Screening - Screen with fully configurable matching algorithms.

text: Rule simulation lets users test rules in seconds without engineers
quote: Rule Simulation - Simulate and test rules in seconds without engineers.

text: Workflow builder for investigation flows tailored to compliance logic
quote: Workflow Builder - Build investigation flows tailored to compliance logic.
